_about: Public-domain W. G. T. Shedd (1820-1894, professor at Union Theological Seminary, New York) for the Word Hoard: Dogmatic Theology (New York: Scribner, 1888, 2 vols, with the supplementary vol. 3 of 1894) and A History of Christian Doctrine (New York: Scribner, 1863, 2 vols), raw Internet Archive OCR. Added 2026-10-03 by lane A, round 9 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted. Extended 2026-10-28 by lane A at Adam's request (his Logos author list): Discourses and Essays, Lectures upon the Philosophy of History, Homiletics and Pastoral Theology, Sermons to the Natural Man and to the Spiritual Man, Theological Essays, Literary Essays, the Romans commentary, The Doctrine of Endless Punishment, The Proposed Revision of the Westminster Standards, Calvinism Pure and Mixed, Orthodoxy and Heterodoxy, and three addresses and sermons. Every printing dated before 1930.
